note: Fuel factors are IPCC 2006 defaults. Only natural gas is confirmed in a document we hold (Guidance No. 5d, Table 4-12). The others must be checked against Section G of Annex II to Implementing Regulation (EU) 2025/2547 before real use.

factors.name: natural_gas
factors.source: IPCC 2006 default, 56.1 tCO2 per TJ, as used in Guidance No. 5d Table 4-12

factors.name: coal
factors.source: IPCC 2006 default for other bituminous coal: 94.6 tCO2/TJ x 25.8 TJ/Gg. Unverified against IR 2025/2547 Annex II section G. Indian coal has a much lower calorific value, so measure it.

factors.name: diesel
factors.source: IPCC 2006 default for gas/diesel oil, 74.1 tCO2 per TJ. Unverified against IR 2025/2547 Annex II section G.

factors.name: grid_india
factors.source: CEA FY2023-24 grid figure of 0.727 tCO2/MWh as reported by a secondary source. Unverified, and not used for iron and steel, where only direct emissions count.
